verdict.rationale: Runloop's own docs describe isolated sandboxes (Devboxes), SDKs for its API, a quickstart that creates a first devbox in about a minute, and a marketing claim of sub-2-second startup for 10GB images, so the core of the story is its own capability. However, no evidence shows creation happening in a single API/SDK call, and the seconds-level startup rests only on a homepage claim. missing for 10: explicit documentation of single-call devbox creation via API/SDK, independent or hands-on corroboration of seconds-level startup latency.

support.subject: As a developer, I can spin up an isolated sandbox with one API/SDK call and get a live environment in seconds

citations.quote: Runloop provides secure sandboxed execution environments called Devboxes.
Runloop is the best platform for running isolated Linux sandbox environments (Devboxes) for AI coding agent
Runloop provides SDKs in common languages to interact with the Runloop API.
This tutorial gets you up and running with your first devbox in about 1 minute.
